high_signal_works.summary_zh: 公司技术报告披露跨模态数据、分层策略与 20 自由度 Genesis Hand 的系统共设计，并展示长时烹饪任务；所有指标均为公司自报，未经过同行评审或独立复现。
high_signal_works.title: GENE-26.5: Advancing Robotic Manipulation to Human Level

high_signal_works.summary_zh: 公司报告发布 Genesis World 1.0 的仿真与 sim-real 相关性结果；代码开放不代表报告中的模型、数据或评测已全部开放，性能数字属于内部评测。
high_signal_works.title: Genesis World 1.0 and the Path Forward

high_signal_works.summary_zh: 保持 video planner 本体无关，仅为各机器人训练基于 Jacobian 的 IDM，形成可替换视频模型的闭环 VERA 路线。
high_signal_works.title: Turning Video Models into Generalist Robot Policies

high_signal_works.summary_zh: 以八项 ICRA 工作展示从仿真训练到真实机器人的技术链，覆盖操作、规划、控制与 Sim-to-Real。
high_signal_works.title: NVIDIA Research Advances Robotics From Simulation to the Real World

high_signal_works.summary_zh: 用离线动作条件 critic 稳定价值学习，再冻结 VLA 基座，以人类介入的 chunk-wise residual 做低风险在线适配。
high_signal_works.title: BORA: Bridging Offline Reinforcement Learning and Online Residual Adaptation for Real-World Dexterous VLA Models

high_signal_works.summary_zh: 以 embodiment-aware prompt 和统一动作—轨迹预测，把操作、导航、轨迹预测及多源数据纳入单一 Qwen-VLA。
high_signal_works.title: Qwen-VLA: Unifying Vision-Language-Action Modeling across Tasks, Environments, and Robot Embodiments

high_signal_works.summary_zh: 以约 5,000 小时双臂真实示范预训练，再用失败纠正轨迹和 HiL DAgger 学习跨服装类别的通用折叠策略。
high_signal_works.title: DeMaVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Foundation Model for Generalizable Deformable Manipulation

high_signal_works.summary_zh: 把可共享、可验证的 Gaussian continuous thoughts 作为 VLA 推理介质，并以教师消费学生 latent 的动作改善来约束推理。
high_signal_works.title: Continuous Reasoning for Vision-Language-Action

high_signal_works.summary_zh: 以共享视频 diffusion backbone 统一动作生成、未来视频模拟和进度评分，并在约 27,300 小时混合数据上训练。
high_signal_works.title: $τ_0$-WM: A Unified Video-Action World Model for Robotic Manipulation
Embodied Interpretability: Linking Causal Understanding to Generalization in Vision-Language-Action Models
Odysseus: Scaling VLMs to 100+ Turn Decision-Making in Games via Reinforcement Learning
MiniVLA-Nav v1: A Multi-Scene Simulation Dataset for Language-Conditioned Robot Navigation
